name: Community Heritage Grant Scheme (Biodiversity & Nature Restoration theme)
summary: Irish heritage grants for community groups and not-for-profit NGOs, with one theme covering habitat and species protection, restoration, invasive species work and biodiversity monitoring. Two-stage process: expression of interest, then a full application if shortlisted.

calls.label: 2027 scheme, Stage 1 expression of interest
calls.note: Full applications (15 January 2027, 5.00pm) are by invitation of shortlisted applicants only

status.quote: Expressions of Interest (EOIs) for the Community Heritage Grant Scheme 2027 closed on 16 October 2026 at 5.00pm.

opens.quote: Key Dates Expression of Interest Opens: 18 September 2026

deadline.quote: Expressions of Interest (EOIs) for the Community Heritage Grant Scheme 2027 closed on 16 October 2026 at 5.00pm.

applicant_types.quote: An annual grant scheme for community groups and not-for-profit non-governmental organisations to protect, share, and celebrate the heritage that matters to your community.

geography.quote: Biodiversity and Nature Restoration supports projects that help protect, restore, enhance or better understand Ireland's natural heritage.

access.quote: Applicants submit a short outline of their project idea, the heritage involved, the need for the project, its community benefits, and how it aligns with one of the scheme themes.

window.quote: Expression of Interest Deadline (Closed): 16 October 2026 at 5.00pm
